boundedExperiment.method: Ajv schema evaluation intersected with the existing validate_analysis function

integrationGap.description: Changing the transport schema and adapter source changes responseSchemaSha256 and adapterSha256 in AnalysisConfig.identity. Existing succeeded receipts then live under a predecessor identity. The current predecessor check overrides only adapterSha256 and policySha256, so it cannot reconstruct a predecessor whose responseSchemaSha256 also changed. Without an explicit compatibility path, cached_state can classify the result as new and permit a resend.
minimumProposal: Bind the exact previous responseSchemaSha256, adapterSha256, and policySha256 as one reviewed predecessor identity.
When that predecessor exists, re-run validate_saved_evidence and verify_full_evidence before reuse.
Reuse only succeeded evidence without rewriting receipt bytes; every non-succeeded predecessor remains readback_required.
Fail closed before provider work if predecessor compatibility is not proven.
Add a regression asserting adapter.invoke is never called and old receipt bytes remain unchanged.
